title: Seimei Shrine
geometryBasis: The shrine guide locates the main hall at the back of the grounds and the separate auxiliary shrine immediately north. The building GSI-derived footprint, documented approach axis and stone step junction align with the cleared front and torii views.
sectionBasis: The shrine confirms its present main sanctuary was built in 1905. Both cleared Qualla photographs show the dark rear pitched roof and the strongly curved front central gable, flanked by lower roof wings.
limitations: Exterior of the main shrine and attached worship frontage only. The separately mapped torii, auxiliary shrines, gift office, precinct sculptures and interiors remain outside the asset.
The combined building footprint and steps establish the model plan and facing. Heights, roof transition and smaller woodwork are visually estimated from the cleared front views.
